title: PROB validates the running stored sum of probabilities against [1 - 4 ULP, 1 + 22 ULP] rather than per-term [0, 1]
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, PROB accumulates the probabilities in input order as binary64 additions and admits any vector whose final sum lies in [1.0 - 4 ULP, 1.0 + 22 ULP] (0x3feffffffffffffc ..= 0x3ff0000000000016), so compensating negative or >1 entries (such as {-0.25, 1.25} or {1e16, -1e16, 1}) are accepted whereas reordered {1e16, 1, -1e16} fails with #NUM!. Non-numeric scalar x_range or prob_range arguments ("2", TRUE, "x") return #DIV/0!.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 across fn4_questions (ql086-ql103) and dc-ymjf.2.79 tests (crates/calc-func/tests/f1_stats.rs), and matched across 2,919/2,919 full-bank PROB rows.
